Run KYB Agent Job

This API endpoint starts a job from a specified agent with a command to be executed.

Args:
    agent_input (AgentJobInputKYB: The model containing the agent key, command, the payload and if you want to run the agent in parallel.
    agent_type (str): The type of the agent (kyb or kyc).
Returns:
    JobIdResponse: A response object containing the status and job ID.
